purpose: Archived project numeric results, not rerun by the synthetic demo.

construction.component: Source geometry and image-footprint construction including cache ingestion. Neural inference, tracking and rendering excluded.

arms.global_recompute: Build full available source prefix before selecting; no camera geometry cache.
arms.global_cached: Build full available prefix before selecting; immutable camera geometry cache.
arms.active_recompute: Select requested five sources before construction; no camera geometry cache.
arms.active_cached: Select requested five sources before construction; immutable camera geometry cache.

construction.limitations: One previously observed recording; sharedGPU; not end-to-end timing, independent-scene timing, memory comparison or a stronger footprint cache.

fusion.conditions: Fixed depth, fixed perception and supplied reference poses. All map-fusion rules share geometry and visibility.

domains.full: All reference image pixels, unknown predictions counted explicitly.
domains.common: Same supported reference pixels for all compared readouts.

fusion.unit: mIoU, coverage, pixel_accuracy are fractions in CSV.
fusion.Bayes_Eq1: Adaptation of the SemanticFusion Bayesian update equation under fixed Gaussian correspondence; not complete system reproduction.
fusion.diagnostic: Native minusBayesian commonmIoU >=5pp perrecord; all3pairedseedchangespositive perrecord; not below singleframecommonmIoU. Not passed.
fusion.limitations: Previously observed recordings; not independentgeography/foundation-pretraining confirmation. Single-frame commonmIoU exceeds nativeGS on both recordings.
